channel.title: Finality
channel.description: Finality reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network incidents, exchange and stablecoin developments, regulation and the projects shaping blockchain.

item.title: How do I tell whether a zkSync Era token is fake?
item.description: How to spot a fake token on zkSync Era: match its contract address to the issuer’s published address, then inspect the contract and holders on the explorer.

item.title: Hong Kong bill targets four crypto service lines
item.description: A Hong Kong bill would extend SFC licensing to crypto dealing, advice, portfolio management and custody, setting a new compliance perimeter for service firms.

item.title: DOJ secures authority to seize or restrain $1.2B in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, part of a wider freeze as investigators trace laundering routes.

item.title: Hong Kong bill extends crypto licensing to four service lines
item.description: Hong Kong gazetted a bill to license virtual-asset dealers, advisers, managers and custodians, extending SFC oversight beyond trading platforms and into asset handling.

item.title: Who Can Upgrade a Canonical Bridge Contract? Follow the Key
item.description: seo_title: Who Can Upgrade a Canonical Bridge Contract? Find the Admin

item.title: DEX swap tax records: how to build a defensible ledger
item.description: How to record DEX swaps for crypto taxes: treat each trade as a disposal and acquisition, price both legs at the timestamp, and keep a row your accountant can verify.

item.title: 1inch Adds Hyperliquid Perpetuals to Its dApp and Android Wallet
item.description: 1inch added Hyperliquid perpetuals to its web dApp and Android wallet, routing supported tokens through USDC into Hyperliquid while keeping execution there.

item.title: How do I see what my LP tokens are worth in a V2 pair?
item.description: To see what your LP tokens are worth, divide your balance by total supply, apply that share to both reserves, then price each token amount for position value.

item.title: Wrapped bitcoin vs real bitcoin: which should a newcomer hold?
item.description: Wrapped bitcoin vs real bitcoin: hold native BTC unless you need a wrapped token for DeFi now; wrappers add custodian or bridge risk and host-chain fees.

item.title: Liquidity pool token prices: How reserves set a quote
item.description: Liquidity pools set token prices through reserve ratios and a pricing curve; trade size, fees and active liquidity shape the swap quote you receive on TRON.

item.title: Does a Multi-Hop Swap Cost More Gas? Compare Your Route
item.description: Does a multi-hop swap cost more gas than a direct swap? Usually yes, because each pool adds transaction work; a better rate can still make it worthwhile.

item.title: Delegated Staking Gives Validators Weight, Not Token Control
item.description: Delegated staking in crypto lets you assign tokens’ validation weight to a validator, earn rewards after commission, and share the risk of slashing.

item.title: How to Claim a Polygon PoS Withdrawal on Ethereum
item.description: How to claim a Polygon bridge withdrawal on Ethereum: wait for the burn checkpoint, submit the exit claim in Polygon Portal, and receive tokens in your wallet.

item.title: US wins authority to seize or restrain $1.2B in Binance funds
item.description: US authorities say court orders cover more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds, within $2.7 billion frozen as laundering continues across crypto services.

item.title: Why Did My Supplied WETH Disappear From MetaMask?
item.description: Why are supplied lending tokens missing from MetaMask? After a SparkLend supply, WETH moves to the reserve and spWETH represents your position.

item.title: Monad bridge cancellation: pending versus included
item.description: Can you cancel a Monad bridge transfer after signing? Only while its source transaction is pending; after inclusion, plan for delivery or a route-specific refund.

item.title: Bridge or Buy on Polygon? Choose the Cheaper Route
item.description: Is it cheaper to bridge or buy tokens directly on Polygon? Starting from fiat, an exchange withdrawal usually costs less; bridging can win for larger Ethereum balances.

item.title: Automated Market Makers: How Constant-Product Pricing Works
item.description: Learn how automated market makers work for beginners: a pool’s reserve ratio sets the spot rate, while trade size and fees determine the output you receive.

item.title: How do Bitcoin bridges handle a chain reorganization?
item.description: How do Bitcoin bridges handle a chain reorganization? Confirmation depth lets the Bitcoin relay wait for a deposit to settle before it can mint tokens.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2B in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from the Binance theft, while providers have frozen $2.7 billion.
